given_when_then.given: A Delivery Partner is logged in and viewing their dashboard
given_when_then.when: The Order Allocation Engine assigns a new delivery task within their service zone
given_when_then.then: The system displays the delivery slot details including route, estimated arrival time, and item list for the partner to accept or reject

given_when_then.given: A Delivery Partner has reached their maximum workload capacity
given_when_then.when: The Order Allocation Engine attempts to assign a new delivery task to that partner
given_when_then.then: The system rejects the assignment and routes the task to another available agent within the same service zone

given_when_then.given: A delivery task is initially assigned to an agent
given_when_then.when: Traffic patterns change significantly after the initial assignment
given_when_then.then: The system recalculates and displays the updated estimated arrival time for the assigned delivery slot

given_when_then.given: A Delivery Partner is assigned a delivery slot
given_when_then.when: The Delivery Partner explicitly accepts the delivery assignment
given_when_then.then: The system confirms the slot as active for the Delivery Partner

success_criteria: The system displays the estimated arrival time for each assigned delivery slot.
The system displays the route details for each assigned delivery slot.
The system updates the estimated arrival time when traffic patterns change significantly.
The system rejects delivery assignments when an agent's current workload exceeds maximum capacity.
The system confirms the slot as active only after an agent explicitly accepts the delivery assignment.
The system does not assign a delivery slot to an agent if their current workload exceeds maximum capacity.
